tools.name: regime
tools.description: Market regime (+ optional ticker context) ($0.004 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/ticker-research/v1/regime). Risk-on / mixed / risk-off score from SPY/QQQ/IWM/TLT trend and SPY realized volatility; with ?symbol= adds that ticker's trend and 21-day relative performance.

tools.name: trend
tools.description: Trend and strength ($0.004 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/ticker-research/v1/trend). Direction (uptrend/sideways/downtrend), strength (ADX), RSI state, % vs 20/50/200-day averages, 5/21/63-day returns, ATR%.

tools.name: levels
tools.description: Key levels ($0.004 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/ticker-research/v1/levels). Nearest level above/below and full sorted list: 20-day and 52-week extremes, pivot/R1/S1, 50/200-day averages, distances in % and ATR.

tools.name: flow
tools.description: Options activity summary ($0.004 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/ticker-research/v1/flow). Nearest-expiry options activity: upside/downside lean, volume and open-interest ratios, max pain, largest open-interest strikes, median implied vol. Summary stats only.

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Shortlist setup status ($0.002 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/ticker-research/v1/setup). Is this ticker on today's Shortlist paper-research board, which setup, reference/invalidation/objective levels, evidence status.

tools.name: brief
tools.description: All-in-one brief ($0.009 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/ticker-research/v1/brief). Regime + trend + levels + options activity + Shortlist status in one answer (cheaper than the five pieces).
